entities.name: Migration Team
entities.rationale: Represents the migration team triggering migration workflows and inputting metadata.

entities.name: Slack
entities.rationale: Chatops tool used by the migration team to issue migration commands.

entities.name: On-Prem
entities.rationale: On-premises source environment and servers to be migrated.

entities.name: App Discovery Service
entities.rationale: AWS Application Discovery Service collecting network connections and server performance data.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Stores migration metadata such as target account, subnet, IP, tags, RTOs, and RPOs.

entities.name: EC2 Migration Factory
entities.rationale: Central EC2 instance running the migration factory automation engine.

entities.name: CloudEndure
entities.rationale: CloudEndure migration agent and service performing block-level continuous replication.

entities.name: EC2 Hot Replica
entities.rationale: Staging hot replica EC2 instance receiving continuously replicated volumes from on-premises.

entities.name: EC2 Target
entities.rationale: Final provisioned EC2 instance launched in the target account.

visual_connections.description: Migration team enters commands into Slack.
Slack invokes API on EC2 Migration Factory to initiate migration.
Operational metadata is recorded into DynamoDB.
Discovery agent on-premises sends TCP connections and performance metrics to App Discovery Service.
Block-by-block data replication stream from on-premises server to EC2 Hot Replica.
Migration factory queries App Discovery Service for metadata.
Migration factory sends API calls to CloudEndure to coordinate and stop replication.
CloudEndure manages the hot replica staging instance.
Migration factory orchestrates launch and tagging of the target EC2 instance across the account boundary.
